scope: Full match total corners, regulation 90 minutes plus stoppage; half-lines. Other scopes and integer/quarter lines retained but excluded from this forecast cohort.

Bet365.summary: Count corners taken, not merely awarded. Retakes count once. Full-match total covers regulation time. Abandonment before 90 minutes voids undetermined bets; already determined bets may stand.
Bet365.automatic_result_scope: Completed regulation matches only; abandonment requires separate evidence review.

Pinnacle.summary: Corners awarded but not taken do not count. Full-match period follows soccer completion rules; early endings and abandonment have specific exceptions.
Pinnacle.automatic_result_scope: Completed regulation matches only; early endings/abandonment require separate evidence review.

price_semantics: Existing adapters identify full-match corner totals upstream. Archive retains the raw normalized rows and reports metadata fields not preserved by those adapters. Recorded prices are not certified executable.
evaluation: A future correction must be registered before analysis; archive installation does not authorize a correction, selection-rule change or historical backfill.
